Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 20-B at 8442 S Marquette
                              Ave - App No. 20622
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                            ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAlNED,BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO: ^



SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the RS3 Single-Unit Detached House District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 20-B in the area bounded by:

           A line 423.62 feet south of and parallel to East 84"' Street; South
           Marquette Avenue; a line 461.26 feet south of and parallel to East 84"'
           Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South Marquette
           Avenue

to those of a RT4 Two-Flat, Townliouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.



Common Address of Property:             8442 South Marquette Avenue
